## File: facebookresearch_metaseq/metaseq/file_io/common/non_blocking_io.py

```
['create a NonBlockingIOManager instance with optional buffered mode and custom ThreadPoolExecutor', 'get a NonBlockingIO instance for a file path with an optional callback after file close', 'write bytes to a file asynchronously using NonBlockingIO without blocking the main thread', 'flush buffered async writes to disk when the buffer exceeds the configured size limit', 'join all async IO threads and wait for pending write jobs to complete before cleanup']
```

```
{'create_nonblocking_io_manager': 'create a NonBlockingIOManager instance with optional buffered mode and custom ThreadPoolExecutor', 'get_nonblocking_io_for_path': 'get a NonBlockingIO instance for a file path with an optional callback after file close', 'write_async_to_file': 'write bytes to a file asynchronously using NonBlockingIO without blocking the main thread', 'flush_buffered_async_writes': 'flush buffered async writes to disk when the buffer exceeds the configured size limit', 'join_async_io_threads': 'join all async IO threads and wait for pending write jobs to complete before cleanup'}
```
